label: Classic
description: Literary typography over a slow accent-coloured light field. Calm enough to sit under eleven minutes of narration without competing with burned-in captions.

bed.//: The bed does NOT depend on the cover, so its cache key is (accent, aspect) — one render per accent, not per book.

short.//: Root data-duration is read at compile time and cannot be driven by --variables, so the renderer must write it into a working copy before rendering.

bedEncode.//: Applied to the BODY encode, replacing codecQualityArgs() defaults. -tune stillimage must also be suppressed: it is correct for a held PNG and wrong for moving content.

measured.//: Recorded during the T0 spike on an M4 Pro against a real 815.951s segment. Timings are machine-specific; ratios are the durable part.
